title: GDLM 71 two moons
desc: A ride through space under two moons: dark, then lighter, then the nebula, then the moon at the drop.
journey: dark space arrival (cube, almost black, a few stars) -> launch into light space (ship then wave, planets close by, navy) -> the nebula (ufo / ball / cube, violet haze) -> deep space climb (wave then ship, darkest part, speed rising) -> the moon rises (a calm cube breath, the moon comes up behind) -> the drop in front of the moon (ship / wave / swing at full pace, moonlit) -> end
oneImage: the drop at 105 s: a huge pale moon filling the back, the ship threading a corridor across its face
never: a bright sky: the background stays near black, lighter only as navy or violet
cube for more than ~20 s in a row
deco or stars in the path's value (roles gate)

song.name: Two Moons ft. Geyser (jamatar)
song.why: 166 BPM, the clearest beat of the local space-named songs (clarity 2.95, 4% beatless), quiet intro then clear drops at 12.6, 35.8 and 105.2 s and a break at 99.4 s: sections for dark / light / nebula variants and one drop for the moon (songmap, 2026-11-24). Alternative: Ocean of Stars (537202, 171 BPM): bigger loud/quiet contrast (17 dB), but its quiet parts are nearly beatless.

feel.density: 2.4-3 obstacles per bar (real levels' median 3.04, tools/pace.js)
feel.pace: 0.63 inputs per beat (official median, tools/tempo.js); busy parts 0.5+
feel.flying: flying modes (ship, ufo, wave, swing, ball) at least 60% of the time

camera: slow zoom-out on the launch, zoom pulses on the drop's bars, a still camera for the moon rise
motifs: planets close to the path in the light parts
the moon growing from the break into the drop

rhythm.sync: portals on section starts and bars; orbs loosely on beats; flying follows the loudness
rhythm.speed: 1x intro, 2x from the launch, 3x only in the drop
